en.title: Minimum Number of Teams with Two Team Sizes
en.description:
Each person belongs to exactly one team, and each team has either a or b people. Split all p people into teams and find the minimum number of teams; output −1 if it is impossible.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: One line with a b p; full original bounds 1≤a,b,p≤100000.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; -1; 1. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Enumerate the number of teams of a people; if the remaining people are divisible by b, that forms a valid plan. Take the plan with the fewest teams.
